theorem: TensorRewrite.Theory.OrderFamily.rewrite_sound (.compareZero direction), with integer_family, signed_family and real_family
lhs: x < 0, 0 > x, x ≥ 0, or 0 ≤ x pointwise.
rhs: Respectively false, false, true, true at every output position.
conditions: The value tensor actually satisfies ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i in the declared order. Source tests IsNonNegative and IsAll(other,0) in the appropriate operand roles after the unsigned zero fast paths.
types: Exact linear order with zero, including signed words under signed interpretation, Int and mathematical Real.
overlap: Historical compareZero family. F32 NaN truth-changing GE/LE examples are retained separately in the existing ledger (nanLeftGE, nanRightLE). No universal source guard or IEEE claim.

lhs: (x < a or, by orientation, a > x) AND (x < b or, by orientation, b > x).
conditions: Both bounds direct effective-scalar S32 constants and both comparisons share the same variable instruction. Each orientation flag selects one syntactic form; source-shape-valid signed comparisons and scalar-like bound construction. Minimum of signed int64 lifts of S32 bounds is one of those bounds and representable.
types: Signed S32 words, homogeneous operands and signed LT/GT comparison. Constants as uniform inputs; common legal comparison/result dimensions.
overlap: Four orientations instantiate one existing tautological conjunction family. HandleAnd dispatch is one call; no additional retained caller ID or new discovery.
